name: branding-open-circle-speech-bubble-logo-on-black
title: Gradient blue ring shaped like a speech bubble with white sans wordmark on black
whatItIs: A black slide with a thick blue ring with one squared bottom-left corner forming a speech bubble, filled with a vertical gradient from deep to bright blue, above a white bold sans wordmark 'NTT CPaaS'.
whatItMeans: Clear and communicative; the bubble ring is simple and friendly.
techniques: Turn a circle into a speech bubble with one squared corner.
Fill with a smooth blue gradient.
Stack a plain white wordmark below.

vocabulary.definition: A logo built from a thick circle.
One corner left sharp to imply a bubble tail.
A colour blend inside the symbol.
